raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

A Mamba host-cache hit can restore the same checkpoint into both a radix-cache slot and an active request's preallocated slot. A derived sidecar (`indices_from_pool=MAMBA`) currently follows only the first matching transfer, leaving the active request's side state stale.

For example, host slot 2 contains `30` and must initialize device slots 4 and 7. Before this fix, the sidecar leaves those slots as `[30, -1]`; afterward they are `[30, 30]`.

## Modifications

- Resolve derived sidecars against all matching source transfers, preserving host/device pairs and the single-source path.
- Sum repeated source transfers when accounting for sidecar bytes.
- Add a registered CPU regression using the real `MambaComponent.build_hicache_transfers()` and `HybridCacheController.load()` paths. It simulates the queued data copy on CPU, checks untouched slots, allocation ownership, and byte accounting, and covers either sidecar ordering with and without an active request.

## Accuracy Tests

On unmodified upstream `c43abd6d9e38a14e81bdb77c648a06353e1c10ee`, the new regression reports **2 failed, 2 passed**: both active-request cases fail and both single-destination controls pass. With the fix, all four pass.

After refreshing onto upstream `5008726431`, the regression and existing staged-transfer suite report **33 passed, 1 skipped, 8 subtests passed**. No model weights or GPUs are needed for this repro.

```bash
PYTHONPATH=python python -m pytest -q \
  test/registered/unit/mem_cache/test_hicache_sidecar_restore.py \
  test/registered/unit/mem_cache/test_hicache_staged_write_back_dispatch.py
```

## Speed Tests and Profiling

No performance claim; this fixes missing state copies and transfer-byte accounting.

## Checklist

- [x] Format code with pre-commit.
- [x] Add registered unit coverage and verify failure before the fix.
- [x] Follow SGLang code style.
- [ ] Update documentation (no user-facing interface change).
- [x] Run the existing MLA HiCache end-to-end tests on two GB300 GPUs.

### Refreshed MLA end-to-end validation

Both existing `TestUnifiedMemoryHiCacheMLA` end-to-end cases also pass on two GB300 GPUs: **2 passed in 289.5 s**, using the registered tiny-random Kimi Linear model. This exercises the refreshed MLA host-pool setup and load-back paths. Local runtime: PyTorch 2.11.0/CUDA 13.2 and FlashInfer 0.7.2, with installed sgl-kernel 0.4.6.post1 and `SGLANG_SKIP_SGL_KERNEL_VERSION_CHECK=1`; upstream expects 0.4.9, so CI remains the check of the pinned environment.

Latest PR Test (Extra): <!-- slot:pr-test-extra:start -->:x: [Run #41101905391](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/41101905391)<!-- slot:pr-test-extra:end -->
Latest PR Test (AMD ROCm 10): <!-- slot:pr-test-amd:start -->:x: [Run #41101906848](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/41101906848)<!-- slot:pr-test-amd:end -->
<!-- pr-states:end -->
## CI follow-up (October 30)

The previous Extra failure was the upstream unified-memory MLA startup bug fixed by #47168 (`8787224bd7`): `MLAView` lacked `hicache_write_back_staging`. This branch now includes that fix through the upstream refresh. The focused CPU suites and both MLA HiCache end-to-end cases pass. Base CI was retried after its wait gate failed on a GitHub jobs API HTTP 500, before test execution. Full upstream CI is still pending.

@@ -0,0 +1,120 @@
+"""Derived sidecars must follow every destination of a Mamba host-cache hit."""
+
+import sys
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import Mock
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.managers.cache_controller import CacheOperation
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.hicache_storage import PoolName, PoolTransfer
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.hybrid_cache.hybrid_cache_controller import (
+    HybridCacheController,
+)
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.page_interleave import PageInterleavePlacement, PageShardSpec
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.unified_cache.components.base import (
+    CacheTransferPhase,
+    ComponentType,
+)
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.unified_cache.components.mamba import MambaComponent
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.unified_cache.unified_tree_core import UnifiedTreeNode
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("active_request", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("sidecar_first", [False, True])
+def test_sidecar_restores_cache_and_request_slots(active_request, sidecar_first):
+    node = UnifiedTreeNode((ComponentType.FULL, ComponentType.MAMBA))
+    node.component_data[ComponentType.MAMBA].host_value = torch.tensor([2])
+    component = object.__new__(MambaComponent)
+    transfers = component.build_hicache_transfers(
+        node,
+        CacheTransferPhase.LOAD_BACK,
+        mamba_pool_idx=torch.tensor(7) if active_request else None,
+    )
+    sidecar = PoolTransfer(name=PoolName.DRAFT, indices_from_pool=PoolName.MAMBA)
+    transfers.insert(0 if sidecar_first else len(transfers), sidecar)
+
+    alloc = Mock(return_value=torch.tensor([4]))
+    free = Mock()
+    controller = object.__new__(HybridCacheController)
+    controller.device = "cpu"
+    controller.is_kv_sharded = False
+    controller.mem_pool_device_allocator = SimpleNamespace()
+    controller.load_queue = []
+    controller.mem_pool_host = SimpleNamespace(
+        anchor_entry=SimpleNamespace(
+            name=PoolName.KV, host_pool=SimpleNamespace(size_per_token=16)
+        ),
+        entry_map={
+            PoolName.MAMBA: SimpleNamespace(
+                device_alloc_fn=alloc,
+                device_free_fn=free,
+                device_evict_fn=None,
+                host_pool=SimpleNamespace(size_per_token=8),
+            ),
+            PoolName.DRAFT: SimpleNamespace(
+                host_pool=SimpleNamespace(size_per_token=4)
+            ),
+        },
+    )
+    result = controller.load(torch.empty(0, dtype=torch.int64), extra_pools=transfers)
+    assert result is not None
+    alloc.assert_called_once_with(1)
+    free.assert_not_called()
+
+    # Simulate the queued copy on CPU: neither destination may retain stale state.
+    host = torch.tensor([10, 20, 30, 40])
+    device = torch.full((8,), -1)
+    device[sidecar.device_indices] = host[sidecar.host_indices]
+    expected = torch.full((8,), -1)
+    expected[4] = 30
+    if active_request:
+        expected[7] = 30
+    torch.testing.assert_close(device, expected)
+    assert controller._transfer_num_bytes(controller.load_queue[0]) == (
+        2 if active_request else 1
+    ) * (8 + 4)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("shard_rank, expected_bytes", [(0, 44), (1, 36)])
+def test_repeated_source_bytes_count_only_local_slots(shard_rank, expected_bytes):
+    controller = object.__new__(HybridCacheController)
+    controller.is_kv_sharded = True
+    controller.mem_pool_host = SimpleNamespace(
+        anchor_entry=SimpleNamespace(
+            name=PoolName.KV,
+            host_pool=SimpleNamespace(
+                size_per_token=16,
+                shard_rank=shard_rank,
+                placement=PageInterleavePlacement(
+                    PageShardSpec(shard_rank, 2, 2, 8, 2)
+                ),
+            ),
+        ),
+        entry_map={
+            PoolName.SWA: SimpleNamespace(host_pool=SimpleNamespace(size_per_token=8)),
+            PoolName.DRAFT_SWA: SimpleNamespace(
+                host_pool=SimpleNamespace(size_per_token=4)
+            ),
+        },
+    )
+    op = CacheOperation(
+        host_indices=torch.tensor([0, 1]),
+        device_indices=torch.tensor([4, 5]),
+        node_id=0,
+        pool_transfers=[
+            PoolTransfer(PoolName.SWA, host_indices=torch.tensor([0, 2])),
+            PoolTransfer(PoolName.SWA, host_indices=torch.tensor([2, 3])),
+            PoolTransfer(PoolName.DRAFT_SWA, indices_from_pool=PoolName.SWA),
+        ],
+    )
+    assert controller._transfer_num_bytes(op) == expected_bytes
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    args = [arg for arg in sys.argv[1:] if arg != "-f"]
+    raise SystemExit(pytest.main([__file__, "-v", "-x", *args]))
